name: Anton Diffring
bio:
Anton Diffring (born Alfred Pollack; October 20, 1918 – May 20, 1989) was a German actor.

Description above from the Wikipedia article Anton Diffring, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

credits.title: The Heroes of Telemark: Location report from Norway
credits.overview: Over one hour of black-and-white location footage and interviews with the stars and director, all staged outdoors in manifestly frigid conditions. Mann talks about his filmmaking philosophy and the challenges of shooting in such rugged locations, and shares his insights on the Douglas-Harris feud.

credits.title: Anna
credits.overview: This film is the theatrical follow-up to a very popular German TV-series (also called "Anna"), about a young girl who wants to make it as a prima ballerina.

credits.title: Doctor Who: Silver Nemesis
credits.overview: The arrival of a mysterious comet heralds impending danger from enemies both old and new. As Ace helps the Doctor defend Earth, she is confronted with a dangerous question..."Doctor Who?"

credits.title: The Making of Doctor Who: Silver Nemesis
credits.overview: In a special documentary made for public television in the United States, Eric Luskin goes behind the scenes of the 25th anniversary story, Silver Nemesis.

credits.title: Faceless
credits.overview: A detective investigating a missing model in Paris uncovers a plastic surgeon’s horrifying secret.

credits.title: Der Sommer des Samurai
credits.overview: In Hamburg, the police are faced with a mystery after a series of burglaries: there are no clues at the crime scene except for a Japanese character. The characters are soon found all over the city. A retired detective and a journalist finally uncover a huge conspiracy that goes back to the Japanese Middle Ages.

credits.title: Wahnfried
credits.overview: Lake Lucerne in 1868: a passionate and forbidden affair flares up between the gifted composer Richard Wagner and the much younger Cosima von Bülow - the aristocrat is already married and the mother of four children. Contrary to all conventions, the two publicly confess their love - and break a social taboo in the proce

credits.title: Marie Ward - Zwischen Galgen und Glorie
credits.overview: The story of Marie Ward, a religious woman from a devout, aristocratic Yorkshire Catholic family who lived between 1585 and 1645 and moved to St. Omer in Walloon France, where she joined the Order of St. Clare, later returning to England to found her own order and devote her life to helping others.

credits.title: The Masks of Death
credits.overview: Sherlock Holmes has retired. But when MacDonald asks him to take on another case, he says yes. There have been some mysterious murders, and there are no visible causes for the deaths. credits.title: Der Besuch
credits.overview: The son of actor Robert Drury is kidnapped, and a strange visitor arrives.

credits.title: S.A.S. San Salvador
credits.overview: Enrique Chacon kills Oscar Romero, a Catholic archbishop in San Salvador. The CIA calls a special agent, Malko Linge, a ruined prince who lives with an expensive woman - Countess Alexandra - to get rid of this nuisance of a man. He does, with many encounters with sweet girls, and macho villains.

credits.title: Non Stop Trouble with Spies
credits.overview: The harmless Berlin taxi driver Herbert Boeckmann has a bad day: Three mysterious gentlemen put the corpse of Boris Stravinsky, a Russian economist, into the car. Unsuspecting Herbert brings the "passenger" to East Berlin. There Boeckmann falls into the clutches of the KGB, who considers him a top agent of the CIA. As

credits.title: Escape to Victory
credits.overview: A group of POWs in a German prison camp during World War II play the German National Soccer Team in this powerful film depicting the role of prisoners during wartime.

credits.title: Tusk
credits.overview: An English girl and an Indian elephant, born on the same day, share a common destiny...

credits.title: Der Durchdreher
credits.overview: The chaotic journalist Maximilian Glanz is working on his big book that will never be finished, answers letters to the editor of a tabloid newspaper and dreams of escaping to an island and leaving everything behind. His marriage is in crisis. And on the day of his divorce, he meets a new woman in a rear-end collision,

credits.title: Son of Hitler
credits.overview: The leader of a right-wing German political party discovers that an illiterate woodcarver is actually the son of Adolf Hitler.

credits.title: Das Einhorn
credits.overview: A copywriter gets famous with his first book. When asked to write a new novel about love for his publisher, he urgently needs tutoring since he doesn't know the first thing about it. His way through the beds leads him to the very young Orli. In her he discovers the true meaning of love, which makes him forget all the w

credits.title: Plutonium
credits.overview: Camouflaged as a political suspense documentary, Plutonium demonstrates the theft of highly enriched nuclear material from a Third World Country nuclear power plant - enough for five bombs of the Hiroshima type. Is this material now in the hands of terrorists – or in the possession of a brutal and inhuman dictatorship?

credits.title: Io sono mia
credits.overview: Vannina and Giacinto are a young married couple who live their relationship in an unequal way; while the girl is submissive to the will of her husband Giacinto, he sees in his bride only the personal object of his sexual satisfaction.

credits.title: Waldrausch
credits.overview: In order to stop the annual flooding, a dam is to be built in the mountain valley; a life-threatening undertaking for the inhabitants.

credits.title: Valentino
credits.overview: The untimely death of silent screen star Rudolph Valentino prompts the many women in his past to reminisce about his troubled rise to superstardom.

credits.title: The Indians Are Still Far Away
credits.overview: A 17-year-old high school student, Jenny Kern, is found dead from cold and exhaustion in the suburbs of Lausanne, Switzerland.

credits.title: Vanessa
credits.overview: Following her parents' death, Vanessa was raised in a convent. Due to an inheritance, she travels to Hong Kong to learn that she inherited a chain of bordellos. Soon, Vanessa has trouble coping as she's thrust into her new world of carnal delights.

credits.title: Montana Trap
credits.overview: Potato Fritz and his friends have moved from Germany to the American Wild West, settling eventually in the Rockies. They are besieged by what appear to them to be hostile Native Americans. Before too long, it becomes clear that the hostiles are in fact a gang of gold thieves. This movie is notable among German-made Wes

credits.title: The Swiss Conspiracy
credits.overview: A Swiss bank discovers some of its clients are becoming the victim of a brilliant blackmailer. The bank's president contacts David Christopher, a former agent with the U.S. Treasury, to help discover who the blackmailer is and to foil his plot. As Christopher delves into the mystery, he uncovers a complicated web of in

credits.title: Operation: Daybreak
credits.overview: Czechoslovakia, 1942. Three brave Czech patriots risk everything to rid their country of its brutal Nazi leader, SS-General Reinhard Heydrich.

credits.title: H.P. Lovecraft: The Shadow Out of Time
credits.overview: Based on H.P. Lovecraft's The Shadow Out of Time, this is the story of a professor who suffers a seizure which results in total amnesia. credits.title: Shatter
credits.overview: Shatter, an international contract killer, has been assigned to assassinate the President of a small African country and collect his fee from a bank in the Far East. On arrival in Hong Kong his life is threatened and when the bank denies all knowledge of payment arrangements, he realises he has been drawn into a danger

credits.title: Only the Wind Knows the Answer
credits.overview: The yacht of millionaire Hellmann explodes in the Mediterranean Sea, with him and 8 men crew on board. Insurance agent Lucas investigates at the Cote D'Azur, because there's the suspicion that it could have been suicide. He finds out that Hellmann's villa was monitored, the tapes also contain information about the expl

credits.title: Borsalino and Co.
credits.overview: Marseille. Heaps of flowers and funeral wreaths... "A man who no longer defends his colors is no longer a man."

credits.title: The Beast Must Die
credits.overview: Wealthy big game hunter Tom Newcliffe has tracked and killed practically every type of animal in the world. But one creature still evades him, the biggest game of all - a werewolf.

credits.title: Kiss Me and Die
credits.overview: When his brother vanishes without a trace, American Robert Stone goes to his last known location: a remote English village. Robert's investigation leads him to the mansion of Jonathon Lanceford, a man obsessed with the Gothic works of Edgar Allen Poe, and his beautiful and enigmatic niece Dominie...

credits.title: Tony Arzenta
credits.overview: A mob hitman wants to retire, but his bosses don't think that's a good idea. Complications - and many bloody shootouts - ensue.

credits.title: The Battle of Sutjeska
credits.overview: The headquarters of the Marshal Tito's Liberation Army are surrounded by Axis forces. The Partisans have no choice but to fight their way out of the encirclement and face the enemy on the plains of Sutjeska.

credits.title: Seven Deaths in the Cat's Eye
credits.overview: In a small Scottish village, horribly murdered bodies keep turning up. Suspicion falls upon the residents of a nearby castle that is haunted by a curse involving a killer cat.

credits.title: Mark of the Devil Part II
credits.overview: A tribunal interrogates, tortures and murders "witches" and "heretics" during the Inquisition.

credits.title: Little Mother
credits.overview: Marina Pinares, the wife of the president of a South American country, insists on being his vice-presidential running mate in the next election. credits.title: Dead Pigeon on Beethoven Street
credits.overview: A private detective infiltrates a gang of drug-dealing extortionists who prey on politicians.

credits.title: The Day the Clown Cried
credits.overview: A circus clown is imprisoned by the Nazis and goes with Jewish children to their deaths.

credits.title: The Iguana with the Tongue of Fire
credits.overview: In Dublin, the acid-scarred, razor-slashed corpse of a young woman is discovered in the boot of the Swiss Ambassador's limousine. credits.title: Zeppelin
credits.overview: The outbreak of World War I places Scots officer Geoffrey Richter-Douglas in an uncomfortable position. Although his allegiance is to Britain, his mother was from an aristocratic Bavarian family, and he spent his summers in Germany as a child. When Geoffrey is approached by a German spy who offers him a chance to defec

credits.title: Piggies
credits.overview: The writer, the publisher, the just-famous poet, the once-famous film director, the dreaded critic, the educated dentist and the half-educated goldsmith are at home in the culture industry, they know their way around, and they have learned to be wary of each other and of themselves: what they have in common is a secret

credits.title: Kill Rommel!
credits.overview: During WWII, US Lieutenant Morris and British captain Hull are assigned in a mission to kill Rommel.

credits.title: Michael Kohlhaas - The Rebel
credits.overview: In medieval times, a horse merchant is forced by a noble to leave part of his stock as payment for crossing his land. Upon returning, he finds his horses near death, and when the noble refuses to compensate him, the merchant fights unsuccessfully against the injustice.

credits.title: Where Eagles Dare
credits.overview: World War II is raging, and an American general has been captured and is being held hostage in the Schloss Adler, a Bavarian castle that's nearly impossible to breach. It's up to a group of skilled Allied soldiers to liberate the general before it's too late.

credits.title: Counterpoint
credits.overview: In December of 1944, Lionel Evans, an internationally renowned American conductor, is on a USO tour with his 70-piece symphony orchestra in newly-liberated Belgium. While fleeing from a German counterattack, Evans and his orchestra members are captured by a Panzer division and taken to an old chateau in Luxembourg. Des

credits.title: The Double Man
credits.overview: In a complex piece of espionage the Russian secret service attempts to kidnap a high ranking officer in the CIA and replace him with a one of its own.

credits.title: Fahrenheit 451
credits.overview: In the future, the government maintains control of public opinion by outlawing literature and maintaining a group of enforcers, known as “firemen,” to perform the necessary book burnings. Fireman Montag begins to question the morality of his vocation…

credits.title: The Blue Max
credits.overview: A young pilot in the German air force of 1918, disliked as lower-class and unchivalrous, tries ambitiously to earn the medal offered for 20 kills.

credits.title: The Heroes of Telemark
credits.overview: Set in German-occupied Norway, resistance fighter Knut Straud enlists the reluctant physicist Rolf Pedersen in an effort to destroy the German heavy water production plant in rural Telemark.

credits.title: Geld, Geld, Geld - 2 Milliarden gegen die Bank von England
Shots in 3/4 Time
credits.overview: B 501, a newly developed controller for missiles, has disappeared despite the strict surveillance. Phillippe Tissout is sent by his boss to Paris to take over the case.

credits.title: Operation Crossbow
credits.overview: Allied agents infiltrate the Nazi rocket complex at Peenemunde in order to obtain their secrets and sabotage the plant. The film alternates between German developments of the V-1 missile and V-2 rocket (with a German cast speaking their own language) and discovery by British Intelligence of the weapon.

credits.title: Lana: Queen of the Amazons
credits.overview: A scientist and his nephew are hosts of Lana, queen of the Amazons, while other crew men try to find and take hold of the legendary Amazons' treasure.

credits.title: Incident at Midnight
credits.overview: In a late night chemist a shot bank robber has been taken for treatment, and to rendezvous with the gang leader.

credits.title: Enter Inspector Duval
credits.overview: Inspector Duval comes to London to help crack the case of a socialite murdered during a jewel heist.

credits.title: Circus of Horrors
credits.overview: A plastic surgeon and his nurse join a bizarre circus to escape from the police. Here he befriends deformed women and transforms them for his "Temple of Beauty". However, when they threaten to leave, they meet with mysterious accidents.

credits.title: The Man Who Could Cheat Death
credits.overview: Dr. Bonner plans to live forever through periodic gland transplants from younger, healthier human victims. Bonner looks about 40; he's really 104 years old. But people are starting to get suspicious, and he may not make 200.

credits.title: Mark of the Phoenix
credits.overview: A jewel thief finds himself a target when a smuggled cigarette case made from a stolen new metal falls into his hands.

credits.title: A Question of Adultery
credits.overview: Mark Loring is madly jealous of his wife, Mary, former American cabaret singer. Due to an automobile accident, she loses her unborn child, and Mark becomes sterile. His father, Brit-stuffy Sir John Loring, has never approved of the marriage and, again, tries to break it up. Believing that a child will hold the marriage

credits.title: Tales of Frankenstein
credits.overview: In this pilot for a series that was never picked up, Dr. Frankenstein has just finished rebuilding his creation, but the monster is unresponsive. He needs to try something different to make it work, perhaps some new parts. Enter a terminally ill sculptor and his assertive wife...

credits.title: Seven Thunders
credits.overview: Escaping British prisoners of war hide out in German occupied France.

credits.title: Lady of Vengeance
credits.overview: When publisher William Marshall learns his young ward Melissa Collins has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove Melissa to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart.

credits.title: The Crooked Sky
credits.overview: An American detective unmasks a gambler as the head of a banknote counterfeiting gang.

credits.title: The Traitor
credits.overview: One time members of a resistance group come together every year to remember their dead leader, betrayed to and executed by the Nazis.  When it seems that they might finally know the name of the traitor - and that he or she comes from within their own unit - their annual gathering becomes a deadly trial...

credits.title: House of Secrets
credits.overview: Police in Paris recruit an English ship's officer (Michael Craig) to help trap counterfeiters by joining them.

credits.title: Reach for the Sky
credits.overview: The true story of airman Douglas Bader who overcame the loss of both legs in a 1931 flying accident to become a successful fighter pilot and wing leader during World War II.

credits.title: Seven Years in Tibet
credits.overview: Heinrich Harrer, an Austrian moutain climber, escapes from a British POW camp in India and flees north across the Himalayan mountains into Tibet. There he meets and befriends the young Dalai Lama.

credits.title: The Black Tent
credits.overview: During the British retreat through Libya, a British officer takes shelter with a group of Arab Bedouin. He marries the chief's daughter. Sometime later, his younger brother, who had believed him to be dead, is informed that he may be alive in Libya - prompting him to set out and search for him.

credits.title: Doublecross
credits.overview: A Cornish fisherman becomes involved with Iron Curtain spies.

credits.title: I Am a Camera
credits.overview: Just before the Nazis ascend to power in Berlin, Chris, an aspiring novelist from England, meets flamboyant cabaret entertainer Sally Bowles and an unusual friendship is born. As Sally feeds her extravagant tastes, Chris goes along for the ride, until their Jewish pal, Fritz, encounters trouble.

credits.title: The Colditz Story
credits.overview: The Germans believed that no man could escape from Colditz Castle, set as it was in the heart of the Reich, 400 miles from any neutral frontier. credits.title: The Sea Shall Not Have Them
credits.overview: During the autumn of 1944, RAF Hudson, carrying a VIP passenger in possession of highly secret information, is shot down and ditches in the North Sea. Fighting the elements and trying to keep up morale, the occupants of the aircraft's dinghy talk about their lives awaiting the rescue they hope will come. The film's tit

credits.title: Operation Diplomat
credits.overview: A physician is forced to operate on a mystery figure under shady circumstances.

credits.title: Albert R.N.
credits.overview: The British inmates of a POW camp think they have an informer among them after several escape attempts fail. One of the prisoners constructs a dummy which they christen "Albert" and use at roll call in order to foil the German guards.

credits.title: Park Plaza 605
credits.overview: Suave private investigator Norman Conquest intercepts a secret message and meets a beautiful but foreign blonde lady in room 605 of the Park Plaza hotel. credits.title: The Red Beret
credits.overview: Steve MacKendrick resigns from the US Army after causing the needless death of a fellow officer. Wanting to serve in the war, he enlists as a Canadian in the British 1st Parachute Brigade. He proves himself exceptionally skilled for a recruit, arousing the suspicion of his commanding officer who starts an investigation

credits.title: Never Let Me Go
credits.overview: An American reporter falls in love with a Russian ballet dancer.

credits.title: Top Secret
credits.overview: A British Sanitary Engineer, goes on holiday with a set of plans for a new secret weapon which he has mistaken for his new plumbing invention. credits.title: The Woman's Angle
credits.overview: The organising force of a family of musical prodigies, Robert Mansell is a frustrated composer in seach of one thing personal happiness. This search, however, has landed him in the divorce courts and the judge's summary does not paint him in a favourable light.

credits.title: Song of Paris
credits.overview: An archetypal Englishman returns from a jaunt abroad to face a dastardly foreign count in a screwball duel for the hand of a beautiful mademoiselle.

credits.title: Appointment with Venus
credits.overview: At the outbreak of WWII the British realise they can't prevent the invasion of the Channel Islands. However, someone realises that a prize cow is on the islands and the Nazis mustn't get hold of her. This is the intrepid story of the cow-napping from under the noses of the Nazis.

credits.title: Hotel Sahara
credits.overview: In World War II, desert hotel proprietors Emad and Yasmin are caught between the warring armies and have to constantly shift their political allegiance to whichever army happens to control the area.

credits.title: Highly Dangerous
credits.overview: A US newsman and a British entomologist spy on germ-warfare research in a mythical country.

credits.title: State Secret
credits.overview: While working in England, an American surgeon Dr. John Marlowe is invited to Vosnia (a fictitious East-European country) to receive an award and demonstrate his life-saving surgery. Unwittingly caught in the middle of a dangerous and corrupt series of political events, Marlowe then becomes the object of a shoot-to-kill

credits.title: Neutral Port
credits.overview: A British merchant ship is torpedoed by a German U-Boat and takes shelter in a neutral port. The Captain then strikes back at the German enemy.

credits.title: Convoy
credits.overview: A tale of life on board a Royal Navy cruiser assigned to protect the vital convoys between America and England during WWII.
